method.advance: At least four additional useful fresh edits across both generators, at least two more than the same-fit context arm, at most one newly flagged ordinary source in each held cohort, and at least 90% edited coverage.
method.cutoff: Strictly exceed the second-highest source-group maximum on 42 dated genuine journal versions. A separate incumbent is the first six native context windows with response at least .5.
method.fit: Retained first-stage report pairs. Sequence alignment labels only inserted or substituted destination words; all text outside the focus and all original words are ordinary. Unchanged words inside edited sentences are unlabeled.
method.held: Twenty fresh same-publisher report works, two generator edits each. Prefer 5 or 6 sentences, keep exact flanks. Exclude previous report groups, source 12-word overlap, and Qwen overlap before any new response. Also include retained genuine forum and USWDS revisions and previously studied eLife ordinary and generated controls.
method.inference: Use complete three-sentence native context and read the contextual token head on each exact word. Fit source-and-class-balanced ridge logistic heads with context only and with contextual word features. Rank each sentence by the mean of its highest quarter of word responses.
method.useful: One highlight must recover at least half of edited nonspace characters with at least .30 IoU.
